Hello, Can someone suggest some place a beginner can start contributing from?

I have tried to read some modules but they seem too complex and I keep backing out... So, can someone recommend some simpler modules which might need work?
I am relatively inexperienced so I don't think I'd be of much help in reviews and such..

I have sent a few safety docs before so I have an understanding of the process though I don't know how to contribute anything meaningful...
Thanks.
